title: Top 20 Octobre press conference announces national mobilization against dynastic rule
location: Radio Oxygène; city not stated in the report
scope: single press conference; follow-up actions were announced for all 23 regions but not verified as executed
organizer: Mouvement Citoyen Top 20 Octobre stop à la dynastie au Tchad
threshold_50_evidence: Not established. The report names three speakers but gives no total attendance or evidence that the press conference was an open public protest gathering. Whether this event qualifies under the public-action definition is unresolved.

start_date.summary: The opened report dates the press conference to Thursday 12 January 2023.

end_date.summary: The report does not state a physical ending time or duration.

location.summary: The report names Radio Oxygène as venue but does not state its city.

scope.summary: One press conference is reported; a future tour and sit-ins across 23 regions are only announced.

organizer.summary: The press conference is attributed to the citizen movement Top 20 Octobre.

demands.summary: The stated theme contrasts democracy with dynastic rule; coded provisionally as a political process demand.

participants_original.summary: No total attendance is reported; three speakers are named, which is not a protest-participant count.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No reported attendance or public access establishes a 50-person public gathering.

protester_violence.summary: The brief report does not describe protester violence; silence is retained as unknown.

state_response.summary: The brief report does not describe a state response to the press conference; all response fields remain unknown.

notes: Provisional meeting lead only. The physical press conference is reported on 12 January; its attendance and status as a public protest are not established. The promised nationwide tour and sit-ins are announcements, not evidence of events. Do not infer that planned actions occurred.
open_questions: Was the press conference open to the public, and did at least 50 people attend?
Did any of the announced sit-ins or other actions occur during January, and where?

title: SET provincial strike in Doba over transport costs and community-teacher payments
organizer: Syndicat des Enseignants du Tchad (SET), provincial branch in Doba (as stated in search result)
threshold_50_evidence: Unknown. The search result reports a strike but no participant count, number of schools/workplaces, or evidence establishing at least 50 participants. The original manual also requires a public labor action; whether this strike involved a public gathering or other public action is unverified.

start_date.summary: Search-result text, not the article body, says the Doba SET strike began 16 January 2023.

end_date.summary: Search-result text says the strike was suspended on 18 January; body retrieval failed, so this remains provisional.

location.summary: The headline and byline in the search result identify the SET provincial branch of Doba.

organizer.summary: Search-result text attributes the strike to the Syndicat des Enseignants du Tchad.

demands.summary: Search-result text says teachers gave the government a deadline to settle 2019–2022 transport costs; further claims about community-teacher subsistence and contracts are also only in the snippet.

participants_original.summary: The available search result contains no number of strikers or affected workplaces.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No size estimate is available; the public character of the labor action also requires verification.

state_response.summary: The search result does not report a government response; all response fields remain unknown.

notes: Search-only lead. Two exact-URL body opens returned Cache miss after separate fresh receipts; neither returned an HTTP status, so this is not classified as a publisher denial. The search result was retained once despite appearing in two related searches; those are not independent reports.
